Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 29
, Reason for Mistake: When first asked to gather counts from the ORCID “Works” section, WebSurfer returned only a high-level bio summary for Manuela Nagel instead of extracting or counting pre-2020 works. This ignored the explicit instruction to identify and count works by year, resulting in no usable data to compute the average. The same behavior recurred later (e.g., step 42), leaving the Orchestrator with insufficient data and leading directly to the incorrect “cannot compute” outcome.
